baseline.worktree_status: uncommitted changes are evaluated against this HEAD

owner_scope.reduction: The first-prompt automatic provider no longer needs a deprecated Session history read; the corresponding no-deprecated and oxlint-disable lines were removed from index.ts.

changes: SessionTitleService.get reads the maintained title projection instead of folding Session history.
The title projection stores accepted title facts as state version 2 while retaining a title-only client view.
The host-only titleInput projection supplies the first eligible message to first-prompt automatic work in O(1) time.
The README and localized README pair document the projection ownership and the remaining complete-history limitation.
retained_exceptions: The all-prompts provider still reads the complete eligible in-memory prefix because storage-backed paging is not available.

The pre-commit title invariant still uses synchronous eventAt and the restore scan still uses snapshotEvents; their local reasons identify the synchronous veto and deferred storage-backed paging requirements.
implementation.configuration_disposition: No repository-wide correctness rule, compiler default, or Session reader allowance changed; those choices remain pending future authority.

commands.observation: The 4,436-file corpus matched the frozen digest and the non-increasing ratchet passed with no violations.

acceptance.summary: This owner-scoped wave reduces the frozen deprecated-reader and suppression counts, keeps every canonical debt metric non-increasing, documents retained local exceptions, and leaves broad lint/compiler policy unchanged.

limitations: This evidence closes only the bounded session-title wave; it does not claim that all AAA-022 static debt is removed.
The remaining complete-history reads require a storage-backed paged reader and a synchronous pre-commit validation seam before migration.
The worktree is uncommitted, and the full repository test suite remains partial under the separate AAA-023 qualification evidence.
